svg.aria-label: ProjectedWrite with a view of one row per entry: a batch of three is committed, which sets the record's flag. The projection writes a row per entry; the second is throttled, so the record is partially projected. Each input is answered on its own: the two whose rows landed are Projected, the throttled one is Committed with its cause. A sweeper finds the flag set, writes only the missing row, and clears the flag. A late duplicate of a row is found present and is not written twice.
svg.text: a row per entry · an answer per input · resume
each row is in the view once
rows are idempotent; the flag clears only when every row is in, fenced on the record
